cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.
